134

2	"""MBR (Minimum Bayes Risk) selection for NER: select sample with highest
3	average entity-set Jaccard overlap with other samples."""
4	
5	import json
6	import sys
7	from collections import defaultdict
8	
9	BASE = "/root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie"
10	
11	DATASETS = {
12	    "SciERC": {
13	        "path": f"{BASE}/output/exp_012_rerun_1024/samples.jsonl",
14	        "max_samples": 8,
15	        "gold_filter": True,
16	    },
17	    "CoNLL": {
18	        "path": f"{BASE}/output/exp_002_conll_n16_r1024/samples.jsonl",
19	        "max_samples": 8,
20	        "gold_filter": False,
21	    },
22	    "FewNERD": {
23	        "path": f"{BASE}/output/exp_027_fewnerd_n16/samples.jsonl",
24	        "max_samples": 8,
25	        "gold_filter": True,
26	    },
27	}
28	
29	
30	def load_data(path, max_samples=8, gold_filter=False):
31	    instances = []
32	    with open(path) as f:
33	        for line in f:
34	            obj = json.loads(line)
35	            if gold_filter and len(obj["gold"]["entities"]) == 0:
36	                continue
37	            samples = obj["samples"][:max_samples]
38	            instances.append({
39	                "id": obj["id"],
40	                "gold": obj["gold"],
41	                "samples": samples,
42	                "greedy": obj["greedy"],
43	                "logprobs": obj.get("logprobs", [])[:max_samples],
44	            })
45	    return instances
46	
47	
48	def text_type_set(sample):
49	    """Entity set as {(text, type)} for MBR overlap computation."""
50	    return frozenset((e["text"], e["type"]) for e in sample.get("entities", []))
51	
52	
53	def span_set(sample):
54	    """Entity set as {(start, end, type)} for F1 evaluation."""
55	    return set((e["start"], e["end"], e["type"]) for e in sample.get("entities", []))
56	
57	
58	def jaccard(set_a, set_b):
59	    if len(set_a) == 0 and len(set_b) == 0:
60	        return 1.0
61	    union = len(set_a | set_b)
62	    if union == 0:
63	        return 1.0
64	    return len(set_a & set_b) / union
65	
66	
67	def mbr_scores(samples):
68	    n = len(samples)
69	    sets = [text_type_set(s) for s in samples]
70	    scores = []
71	    for i in range(n):
72	        total = sum(jaccard(sets[i], sets[j]) for j in range(n) if j != i)
73	        scores.append(total / (n - 1))
74	    return scores
75	
76	
77	def entity_f1(pred_sample, gold):
78	    pred = span_set(pred_sample)
79	    gold_s = span_set(gold)
80	    if len(pred) == 0 and len(gold_s) == 0:
81	        return 1.0
82	    if len(pred) == 0 or len(gold_s) == 0:
83	        return 0.0
84	    tp = len(pred & gold_s)
85	    p = tp / len(pred)
86	    r = tp / len(gold_s)
87	    if p + r == 0:
88	        return 0.0
89	    return 2 * p * r / (p + r)
90	
91	
92	def degeneracy_ratio(samples):
93	    """Fraction of unique (text,type) entity sets among N samples.
94	    1/N = fully degenerate (all identical), 1.0 = all distinct."""
95	    sets = [text_type_set(s) for s in samples]
96	    n_unique = len(set(sets))
97	    return n_unique / len(samples)
98	
99	
100	def evaluate_dataset(name, cfg):
101	    instances = load_data(cfg["path"], cfg["max_samples"], cfg["gold_filter"])
102	    n = len(instances)
103	
104	    greedy_f1s, lp_f1s, mbr_f1s, oracle_f1s = [], [], [], []
105	    degen_ratios = []
106	
107	    for inst in instances:
108	        gold = inst["gold"]
109	        samples = inst["samples"]
110	        logprobs = inst["logprobs"]
111	
112	        greedy_f1s.append(entity_f1(inst["greedy"], gold))
113	
114	        if len(logprobs) == len(samples):
115	            lp_idx = max(range(len(logprobs)), key=lambda i: logprobs[i])
116	        else:
117	            lp_idx = 0
118	        lp_f1s.append(entity_f1(samples[lp_idx], gold))
119	
120	        scores = mbr_scores(samples)
121	        mbr_idx = scores.index(max(scores))
122	        mbr_f1s.append(entity_f1(samples[mbr_idx], gold))
123	
124	        best_f1 = max(entity_f1(s, gold) for s in samples)
125	        oracle_f1s.append(best_f1)
126	
127	        degen_ratios.append(degeneracy_ratio(samples))
128	
129	    greedy_avg = sum(greedy_f1s) / n
130	    lp_avg = sum(lp_f1s) / n
131	    mbr_avg = sum(mbr_f1s) / n
132	    oracle_avg = sum(oracle_f1s) / n
133	
134	    # Degeneracy-grouped analysis
135	    # Low diversity: unique_ratio <= 0.25 (1-2 unique sets out of 8)
136	    # Medium: 0.25 < ratio <= 0.625 (3-5 unique)
137	    # High: ratio > 0.625 (6-8 unique)
138	    degen_groups = {"low_diversity": [], "medium": [], "high_diversity": []}
139	    for i, dr in enumerate(degen_ratios):
140	        if dr <= 0.25:
141	            degen_groups["low_diversity"].append(i)
142	        elif dr <= 0.625:
143	            degen_groups["medium"].append(i)
144	        else:
145	            degen_groups["high_diversity"].append(i)
146	
147	    degen_results = {}
148	    for group_name, indices in degen_groups.items():
149	        if not indices:
150	            degen_results[group_name] = None
151	            continue
152	        gn = len(indices)
153	        degen_results[group_name] = {
154	            "count": gn,
155	            "greedy": sum(greedy_f1s[i] for i in indices) / gn,
156	            "lp": sum(lp_f1s[i] for i in indices) / gn,
157	            "mbr": sum(mbr_f1s[i] for i in indices) / gn,
158	            "oracle": sum(oracle_f1s[i] for i in indices) / gn,
159	        }
160	
161	    return {
162	        "name": name, "n": n,
163	        "greedy": greedy_avg, "lp": lp_avg,
164	        "mbr": mbr_avg, "oracle": oracle_avg,
165	        "degen": degen_results,
166	    }
167	
168	
169	def main():

171	    for name, cfg in DATASETS.items():
172	        r = evaluate_dataset(name, cfg)

    "SciERC_5epoch": f"{BASE}/output/exp_012_rerun_1024/samples.jsonl",
}

def entity_set(entities):
    return {(e["text"], e["type"]) for e in entities}

def f1_score(pred_set, gold_set):
    if not pred_set and not gold_set:
        return 1.0
    if not pred_set or not gold_set:
        return 0.0
    tp = len(pred_set & gold_set)
    p = tp / len(pred_set)
    r = tp / len(gold_set)
    return 2*p*r/(p+r) if (p+r) > 0 else 0.0

def bootstrap_ci(data, n_boot=10000, ci=0.95):
    data = np.array(data)
    if len(data) == 0:
        return None, None
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    boot_medians = []
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        idx = rng.integers(0, len(data), size=len(data))
        boot_medians.append(np.median(data[idx]))
    boot_medians = np.array(boot_medians)
    lo = np.percentile(boot_medians, (1-ci)/2*100)
    hi = np.percentile(boot_medians, (1+ci)/2*100)
    return round(float(lo), 4), round(float(hi), 4)

58	def jaccard(set_a, set_b):
59	    if len(set_a) == 0 and len(set_b) == 0:
60	        return 1.0
61	    union = len(set_a | set_b)
62	    if union == 0:
63	        return 1.0
64	    return len(set_a & set_b) / union

70	    scores = []

86	    r = tp / len(gold_s)
87	    if p + r == 0:

    """Extract scaling-relevant metrics from a unified result JSON file.

    Expected format: {per_seed: {seedN: {...}}, summary: {...}}
    or flat format: {greedy_macro_f1: ..., oracle_macro_f1: ..., ...}
    """
    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    if "summary" in data:
        s = data["summary"]
        greedy = s.get("greedy_macro_f1", {}).get("mean")
        oracle = s.get("oracle_macro_f1", {}).get("mean")
        degen = s.get("degeneracy_rate_pct", {}).get("mean")

    else:
        greedy = data.get("greedy_macro_f1") or data.get("greedy_f1")
        oracle = data.get("oracle_macro_f1") or data.get("oracle_f1")
        degen = data.get("degeneracy_rate_pct") or data.get("degeneracy_rate")
        if degen and degen < 1:
            degen *= 100
        lp_rho = data.get("lp_spearman_global") or data.get("lp_rho")
        lp_delta = data.get("lp_selection_delta_pp") or data.get("lp_delta_pp")
        n_seeds = 1

    headroom = (oracle - greedy) * 100 if greedy and oracle else None

    return {
        "greedy_f1": greedy,
        "oracle_f1": oracle,
        "headroom_pp": round(headroom, 2) if headroom else None,

        "lp_rho": round(lp_rho, 4) if lp_rho else None,
        "lp_delta_pp": round(lp_delta, 2) if lp_delta else None,
        "n_seeds": n_seeds,
    }


def aggregate(extra_json_paths: list[tuple[str, dict]] = None) -> list[dict]:
    """Merge KNOWN_RESULTS with any additional JSON result files.

    extra_json_paths: list of (path, metadata_dict) where metadata_dict has
        keys: model, family, size_b, dataset, regime
    """
    results = list(KNOWN_RESULTS)

    if extra_json_paths:
        for path, meta in extra_json_paths:
            if not os.path.exists(path):
                print(f"WARNING: {path} not found, skipping", file=sys.stderr)
                continue
            parsed = load_from_unified_json(path)
            row = {**meta, **parsed}
            row.setdefault("constr_delta_pp", None)
            results.append(row)

    results.sort(key=lambda r: (r["dataset"], r["regime"], r["size_b"], r["family"]))
    return results


def print_table(results: list[dict]):
    header = f"{'Model':<16} {'Size':>5} {'Dataset':<8} {'Regime':<10} " \
             f"{'Greedy':>7} {'Oracle':>7} {'Head':>6} {'Degen%':>7} " \
             f"{'LP rho':>7} {'LP D':>6} {'C D':>6}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    for r in results:
        def fmt(v, w=7, d=4):
            return f"{v:{w}.{d}f}" if v is not None else " " * (w - 1) + "-"
        def fmt2(v, w=6, d=2):
            return f"{v:{w}.{d}f}" if v is not None else " " * (w - 1) + "-"

        print(f"{r['model']:<16} {r['size_b']:>5} {r['dataset']:<8} {r['regime']:<10} "
              f"{fmt(r['greedy_f1'])} {fmt(r['oracle_f1'])} "
              f"{fmt2(r.get('headroom_pp'))} {fmt2(r.get('degen_pct'))} "
              f"{fmt(r.get('lp_rho'))} {fmt2(r.get('lp_delta_pp'))} "
              f"{fmt2(r.get('constr_delta_pp'))}")


def save_csv(results: list[dict], path: str):
    with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=METRIC_KEYS, extrasaction="ignore")
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(results)
    print(f"Saved CSV: {path}")


def save_json(results: list[dict], path: str):
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"Saved JSON: {path}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Aggregate scaling results")
    parser.add_argument("--extra", nargs="*", help="extra_path:model:family:size:dataset:regime")
    parser.add_argument("--out-csv", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--out-json", default=None)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    extra = []
    if args.extra:
        for spec in args.extra:
            parts = spec.split(":")
            if len(parts) != 6:
                print(f"ERROR: --extra format is path:model:family:size:dataset:regime, got {spec}",
                      file=sys.stderr)
                sys.exit(1)
            path, model, family, size, dataset, regime = parts
            extra.append((path, {
                "model": model, "family": family, "size_b": float(size),
                "dataset": dataset, "regime": regime,
            }))

    results = aggregate(extra if extra else None)
    print_table(results)

    if args.out_csv:
        save_csv(results, args.out_csv)
    if args.out_json:
        save_json(results, args.out_json)

    default_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    if not args.out_csv and not args.out_json:
        csv_path = os.path.join(default_dir, "scaling_results.csv")
        json_path = os.path.join(default_dir, "scaling_results.json")
        save_csv(results, csv_path)
        save_json(results, json_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    fam = FAMILY_STYLE.get(d["family"], DEFAULT_FAMILY)

def plot_panel(ax, data: list[dict], metric_key: str, ylabel: str, fmt_func=None):
    """Plot one metric panel. Only includes points where metric is not None."""
    points = [(d, d[metric_key]) for d in data if d.get(metric_key) is not None]
    if not points:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No data", transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=8, color="#999999")
        ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=8)
        return

    plotted_labels = set()
    for d, val in points:
        style = get_style(d)
        label_key = f"{d['family']} ({d['regime'].upper()})"
